_purpose: Dependency advisory exception register (docs/P7_PLAN.md §6.3). Suite D fails on every critical/high npm advisory unless a complete, human-approved entry here names it.
_rules: An entry needs ALL seven fields. An entry missing one is not an exception; the advisory keeps failing the gate.
approver must name a real human who approved it. Placeholders (TBD, pending, an agent name) are rejected.
review_date must be a future date. A passed review date re-reds the gate.
Never add an entry to make a build green. Remediate first; except only what cannot be remediated compatibly.
Moderate advisories do not need an entry — they are documented in docs/P7_SUPPLY_CHAIN_REVIEW.md.
